info.senderName: Agencija Republike Slovenije za okolje (ARSO vreme)
info.headline: Veter - zmerna ogroženost (Stopnja 2/4) - Slovenija / jugozahod
info.description: Maksimalna hitrost vetra : od 70 do 85 km/h. Veter maje drevesa in lahko že lomi veje. Ovira cestni promet določenih kategorij in lahko že nekoliko otežuje gibanje. Morje je zmerno vzvalovano (3).
info.instruction:
Pred dogodkom: zaprite vsa okna in vrata. Pospravite ali pritrdite vse, kar bi veter lahko raznašal. Preverite stanje privezov plovil.
Med dogodkom: vrata in okna naj bodo zaprta. Pri gibanju na prostem bodite pozorni na morebitne padajoče predmete. Prekinite delo na višini. Ne popravljajte škode med dogodkom. Priporočamo dodatno previdnost v prometu predvsem v primeru bočnega vetra in na izpostavljenih mestih (npr. mostovi, useki). Priporočamo previdnost pri izvajanju vodnih športov. Manj vešči jadralci naj ne izplujejo na morje. Kopalci naj se zadržujejo v bližini obale.

parameter.value: Maksimalna hitrost vetra : od 70 do 85 km/h.

info.senderName: Slovenian Environment Agency (ARSO vreme)
info.headline: Moderate Wind Warning (Degree 2/4) - Slovenia / South-West
info.description: Maximum wind speed : from 70 to 85 km/h. Wind sways trees and may break branches. It impedes road traffic of certain categories and may hinder movement to some extent. The sea is fairly rough (3).
info.instruction:
Before the event: Close all windows and doors. Stow or fasten anything that could be carried away by the wind. Check the situation of vessels in berths.
During the event: Doors and windows should be kept closed. When moving in the open, pay attention to possible falling objects. Stop all work at heights. Do not repair damage during the event. We recommend additional caution in traffic, especially in crosswinds and in exposed areas (e.g. bridges, cuttings). Caution is recommended in water sports. Less skilled sailors should not sail out. Swimmers should stay close to the shore.

parameter.value: Maximum wind speed : from 70 to 85 km/h.

info.headline: Moderate Rain Warning (Degree 2/4) - Slovenia / South-West
info.description: Rainfall : from 25 to 50 mm/24h. Watercourses may overflow in areas usually prone to annual floods. Debris may clog certain river culverts.
info.instruction: The population in the affected areas should follow the trend of water level and hydrological updates.
